backend/main.mo: Main actor for the ProFi Mine backend, managing mining projects, user profiles (with subscription tiers and ROM usage tracking), sensitivity ranges, Stripe configuration, and persistent logging with access control and HTTP outcalls.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that upgrades OldUserProfile records to the new UserProfile shape by adding a romUsageCount field initialized to 0.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (removing Save/Load buttons, ROM usage gating, ProjectContext updates) to their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, used as a build/planning reference for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors for backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the ProFi Mine React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router with routes for login (/), dashboard (/dashboard), payment success, and payment failure pages, all under a shared root component.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading state and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: A modal dialog for new users to set up their profile by entering name, email, organization, and choosing between free or premium subscription tiers. Submits the profile via a mutation hook and shows toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/charts/CostBreak: Renders a pie chart breaking down total mining costs (mining, processing, G&A, royalties, closure) using Recharts, with a download button that exports only the chart area as an image.
frontend/src/components/charts/Cumulativ: Displays a line chart of cumulative free cash flow over the project lifetime using Recharts, starting from the negative initial capex at Year 0, with an export-to-image button.
frontend/src/components/charts/Productio: Renders a bar chart of annual recovered metal production in kilograms using Recharts, with a download button to export the chart as an image.
frontend/src/components/common/InfoToolt: A small reusable component that renders a help-circle icon with a tooltip displaying a provided text string on hover.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Sticky top header showing the app logo, current project name, subscription tier badge, usage counts, and a login button; clicking the usage area opens a SubscriptionModal.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportTab: Provides export options for the project's financial data, including a CSV export button that is disabled when free-tier export quota is exhausted, with relevant alerts and badge indicators.
frontend/src/components/guide/Glossary.t: Renders a searchable accordion glossary by filtering entries from a GLOSSARY constant based on user input, displaying term names and definitions.
frontend/src/components/guide/UsageGuide: Renders a usage guide page with a sticky table of contents sidebar and main content area displaying guide sections and a glossary using accordion-style layout.
frontend/src/components/inputs/CostStruc: Form section for entering mining project cost structure inputs including CAPEX, OPEX (mining, processing, G&A), royalties, and related fields with tooltips.
frontend/src/components/inputs/DynamicAr: Reusable component for editing a dynamic year-by-year array of numeric values, with add/remove year buttons and per-year labeled inputs.
frontend/src/components/inputs/EconomicP: Form section for entering economic parameters such as inflation rate, discount rate, tax rate, and a dynamic per-year commodity price forecast.
frontend/src/components/inputs/Financing: Form section for entering project financing parameters including equity ratio and interest rate, with tooltip descriptions.
frontend/src/components/inputs/InputsTab: Composes all input form sections (reserves, economic parameters, cost structure, financing) into a single tabbed card layout for project input entry.
frontend/src/components/inputs/ReservesP: Form section for reserves and production inputs (ore reserves, grade, recovery rate, stripping ratio, ROM tonnage schedule) with free-tier usage limits and a subscription modal gate.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root layout component wrapping the app with a theme provider, router outlet, toast notifications, and a footer with branding.
frontend/src/components/layout/RootCompo: Top-level component that renders AppLayout and conditionally shows a ProfileSetupModal when an authenticated user has no profile yet.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentF: Displays a payment failure screen with common failure reasons and buttons to retry (navigate to dashboard) or contact support.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentS: Displays a payment success confirmation screen, invalidates the user profile query to refresh subscription status, and provides a link back to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/project/ProjectL: Modal dialog that lists saved projects with options to load or delete each one, using query hooks and toast notifications for feedback.
frontend/src/components/project/SaveProj: Modal dialog for saving a project by name, enforcing subscription-based usage limits and prompting an upgrade modal when the limit is reached.
frontend/src/components/projections/Cash: Renders a scrollable table showing yearly OCF, CAPEX, closure costs, free cash flow, and cumulative FCF from project calculations.
frontend/src/components/projections/Inco: Renders a scrollable yearly income statement table with revenue, OPEX, royalties, EBITDA, taxes, and net income from project calculations.
frontend/src/components/projections/Proj: Composes the full projections view by combining KPI summary, charts (cash flow, production, cost breakdown), income statement, and cash flow statement cards.
frontend/src/components/projections/Summ: Displays a simple two-column table of key financial KPIs (NPV, IRR, ROI, LOM, EBITDA, payback period) derived from project calculations.
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Scen: Shows a comparison table of NPV, IRR, ROI, and LOM across base, optimistic, and pessimistic scenarios, with edit buttons that open a ScenarioEditor dialog.

A dialog component for editing scenario parameters (base, optimistic, pessimistic) that allows users to adjust commodity price, ore grade, recovery rate, CAPEX, and OPEX as percentage changes, saving updates via ScenarioContext.
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Sens: A UI panel with sliders for adjusting five key mining variables (±20%) and displays adjusted NPV, IRR, and ROI results compared to base values using the SensitivityContext.
A tab layout component that composes SensitivityControls, SensitivityTornado, and ScenarioComparison into two cards for sensitivity analysis and scenario comparison.
Renders a horizontal tornado bar chart using Recharts showing the NPV impact of ±20% variation in key variables, sourced from SensitivityContext's tornadoData.
frontend/src/components/subscription/Sub: A modal dialog displaying current tier usage and upgrade options, initiating a Stripe checkout session for a Premium subscription via the useCreateCheckoutSession hook.
frontend/src/config/stripe.ts: Exports the Stripe publishable key constant for use in frontend payment flows.
frontend/src/constants/glossary.ts: Exports a record of mining and financial term definitions (e.g., NPV, IRR, CAPEX) used for in-app glossary tooltips or help text.
frontend/src/constants/guideContent.ts: Exports structured guide content with HTML sections covering application overview, getting started steps, input parameter explanations, and financial calculation formulas for an in-app user guide.
frontend/src/contexts/ProjectContext.tsx: Provides a React context for managing mining project state including financial inputs, calculations, project save/load operations, and user subscription/usage tracking.
frontend/src/contexts/ScenarioContext.ts: Provides a React context for managing base/optimistic/pessimistic scenario comparisons by applying percentage adjustments to project inputs and recalculating NPV, IRR, ROI, and LOM.
frontend/src/contexts/SensitivityContext: Provides a React context for sensitivity analysis, computing adjusted financial results and tornado chart data by varying commodity price, ore grade, recovery rate, CAPEX, and OPEX by ±20%.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChartExport.ts: Custom hook that exports a chart's SVG element to a PNG file by cloning the SVG, inlining computed styles, rendering to a 2x-resolution canvas, and triggering a download.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Custom hook that wraps a React Query mutation to call the backend's createCheckoutSession method with shopping items and return a parsed Stripe checkout session URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useExcelExport.ts: Hook that exports project financial data as a CSV file, checking and decrementing the user's export quota via the backend actor before generating the download.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/usePdfExport.ts: Hook that triggers a browser print dialog for PDF export after verifying and decrementing the user's export quota, with a delay to ensure charts are fully rendered.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, mining projects, and Stripe configuration via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet configuring Tailwind, mining-themed CSS custom properties for light/dark modes, and print styles that isolate the Projections tab content for PDF export.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page that renders a five-tab layout (Inputs, Projections, Sensitivity, Export, Guide) within ProjectProvider and ScenarioProvider, redirecting unauthenticated users to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login page for ProFi Mine with an Internet Identity login button, redirecting authenticated users to the dashboard. Displays app branding, a background image, and a feature list.
frontend/src/types/external.d.ts: Empty TypeScript declaration file intended for external module type definitions.
frontend/src/utils/calculations.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for project inputs and financial outputs, and implements financial calculation logic including yearly cash flows, NPV, IRR, and payback period for mining projects.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides utility functions for formatting numbers as currency, percentages, plain numbers, and dates for display in the UI.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with OKLCH-based design tokens, custom border radii, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state including implemented and pending features, architectural notes, and known issues; documents the Free Tier ROM usage limit and removal of Save/Load model functionality.
